aapl.text: Apple’s largest fall was 41.5%, and it recovered to its previous high 8 months after the low.

azn.text: AstraZeneca’s largest fall was 41.0%, and it recovered to its previous high 24 months after the low.

btc.text: Bitcoin’s largest fall was 74.2%, and it recovered 21 months after reaching its low.

iglt.text: The UK government bond fund fell 31.9% from its high and remained 25.9% below that high at the end of Aug 2026.

msft.text: Microsoft’s largest fall was 35.5%, and it recovered to its previous high 9 months after the low.

nvda.text: Nvidia fell 72.5% in its largest decline and regained its previous high 83 months after the low.

sgln.text: The physical gold fund’s largest fall was 38.2%, and it took 95 months to regain its previous high.
